noAccess.title: No reports access
noAccess.reason: Only owners, admins and managers can see sales reports at {branch}.

export.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Reload the page and sign in again.
export.failed: {kind} export failed ({status}). Try again, or contact support.

failed.title: Reports could not be loaded
failed.body: Your sales data is safe — this is a problem reading it, not a problem with your orders. Reload the page; if it keeps happening, send the error below to support.

empty.title: No orders between {from} and {to}
empty.body: Reports loaded fine — this branch just hasn’t taken an order in this window. Try a wider range above.

crash.title: Something broke while drawing your reports
crash.body: Your orders and sales data are untouched. Try again — if it keeps failing, contact support.

frame.body: Your data is safe — this is a problem reading it. Reload the page; if it keeps happening, send the error below to support.

errors.forbidden: Your account can’t read reports for this branch. If that’s wrong, sign out and sign in again.
errors.rangeTooWide: That range is too long. Choose 366 days or fewer.
errors.rangeRequired: Choose a start and end date to load this report.
errors.emptyResponse: The reports service returned an empty response.
errors.unknown: The reports service hit an unexpected error.

sales.title: Sales & revenue
sales.caption: Gross is what the food sold for. Net takes off discounts and refunds.
sales.byDayCaption: Refunds sit on the day the money went back out, which may not be the day the order was taken.
sales.breakdownCaption: Gross receipts is every dollar that changed hands, tax, fees and tips included — the figure this screen used to call “Revenue”.

orders.title: Orders
orders.caption: Every order in the range, cancellations included — so the rates below have an honest denominator.
orders.byStatusCaption: This list was fetched but never drawn before, so a cancelled order had nowhere to appear.
orders.scheduledCaption: Counted by when the order was placed, not by the slot it was booked into.

menu.title: Menu
menu.caption: What sold, by dish, category and combo — plus what promotions gave away.
menu.itemsSoldHint: {count, plural, one {# different item} other {# different items}}
menu.comboRevenueHint: Was missing from By category entirely
menu.promoGiveawayHint: {count, plural, one {# order used a code} other {# orders used a code}}
menu.byItemCaption: Top 100 items by revenue; click a heading to re-sort.
menu.byCategoryCaption: Combos land in their own band now. They used to disappear here, because a combo line carries no menu item to join a category on.
menu.topCombosEmpty: No combo sold in this range.
menu.promosEmpty: No promo code was used in this range.
menu.promosCaption: Counted from the code stamped on each order, so a guest who used a code is included — the redemption ledger only records signed-in diners.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.caption: Deliveries for orders taken in this range, timed from the rider’s own stamps.
delivery.howItWentCaption: On-time percentage is not shown: no promised-delivery time is recorded anywhere, so there is nothing honest to measure lateness against.
delivery.starsEmpty: No diner rated a delivery in this range.
delivery.ratingsLink: <link>Full reviews live on the Ratings page</link>.
delivery.byRiderEmpty: No rider took a delivery in this range.

notOffered.title: {branch} does not deliver
notOffered.body: Delivery is chosen branch by branch, so there is nothing to report here. Your other branches keep their own delivery reports.
notOffered.link: Turn delivery on for this branch

customers.title: Customers & loyalty
customers.caption: Diners who completed an order in this range, whether they had been here before, and what loyalty cost.
customers.onFileHint: Everyone who signed in or ordered at this branch, all time
customers.activeHint: {count} with two or more completed orders
customers.guestOrders: {count, plural, one {# order was placed without an account, so new and returning will not add up to the order count.} other {# orders were placed without an account, so new and returning will not add up to the order count.}}
customers.topEmpty: No signed-in diner ordered in this range.
customers.topCaption: Orders and spend count this range’s completed orders at this branch, the rule the Customers page uses, so they never exceed Lifetime here: orders still in progress, refunded or cancelled are left out. Lifetime here is every completed order the diner has placed at this branch.
customers.pointsCaption: This branch’s points only: each branch runs its own loyalty programme. Points given back on cancelled or refunded orders, birthday gifts and staff adjustments each have their own line, so the lines add up to the change in members’ balances.
customers.couponsEmpty: No coupon was used in this range.
customers.couponsCaption: {count, plural, one {# order carried a code} other {# orders carried a code}}, worth {amount}.

payments.title: Payments & refunds
payments.caption: Every payment attached to an order taken in this range, by method and state.
payments.gridEmpty: No payment was taken in this range.
payments.gridCaption: A card payment sitting in Pending has not been charged — no card gateway key is configured yet, so those rows are waiting rather than failing.
payments.refundsCaption: A refund is recorded against the order, not against the payment, so the Refunded column in the grid above reads zero by design. The figure to trust is the first line here.
payments.awaitingBody: Orders already handed to the diner whose payment is still pending.
